Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL now available in South Africa regions

Body.Content:
With the aim of providing customers with best in class experience of a managed database offering for PostgreSQL databases, we are pleased to announce that Azure Database for PostgreSQL is now generally available in the recently announced regions of South Africa North and South Africa West. With the addition of Azure Database for  PostgreSQL to these regions, customers can now use this cloud-based opportunity to accelerate innovation, support people across the continent who are working to transform their businesses, explore new entrepreneurship opportunities, and help solve some of the world’s hardest problems.

For up-to-date info about regional availability of Azure Database for PostgreSQL, see Products available by region.
